'''R-3PO''' ('''Ar-Threepio''') was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Known for his distinctive red [[Color/Legends|coloring]], a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on his left posterior plating that read "Thank The Maker," and a moody disposition, R-3PO was stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. After his original owner, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Chaz]], purposely left R-3PO at the base for the Rebels to deal with, Alliance [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Palo Torshan]] recommended he be used as an [[espionage droid]] to uncover [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial espionage droid|spy droids]]. R-3PO successfully helped to foil several Imperial [[Spy/Legends|infiltration]] attempts while serving at the base and, subsequently, with High Command.

==Biography==
===A flamboyant annoyance===
R-3PO, or Ar-Threepio,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|"R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)"}}</ref> was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-plated [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Originally the property of [[Chaz]], one of the Rebellion's most notorious [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], R-3PO was "accidentally" left behind at the Alliance's secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where<ref name="Who's Who" /> he<ref name="CSWE" /> soon became a general annoyance because of his moody disposition.<ref name="Who's Who" />

Knowing that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] typically made a habit of [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] as [[Spy/Legends|spies]] in the hopes that they would eventually find their way into the Rebel Alliance, Echo Base's [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Palo Torshan]], one of the top security personnel present, suggested that R-3PO be reprogrammed to combat the threat of [[Imperial espionage droid]]s. R-3PO would be set loose among Echo Base's droid pool, ferreting out those [[Espionage droid|droid spies]]. Additionally, Torshan recommended that R-3PO not be given a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] and to leave his exterior skeleton its conspicuous red color&mdash;after all, he reasoned, who would suspect a flamboyant, temperamental [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] of doubling as a spy?<ref name="Who's Who" />

===Echo Base espionage droid===
[[File:R-3PO.jpg|thumb|right|175px|R-3PO served as a spy droid while at Echo Base.]]
The Alliance specially modified R-3PO to perform his espionage duty by detecting spies through careful observation of his peers.<ref name="SWE" /> Indeed, R-3PO proceeded to help foil several Imperial infiltration attempts during his service at Echo Base,<ref name="Who's Who" /> while no one suspected a thing,<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a testament to Torshan's insight.<ref name="Who's Who" /> R-3PO's responsibilities on Hoth also included serving in the base's command center.<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which includes R-3PO's service at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> R-3PO was present in Echo Base's central [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] returned from a routine [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission of Hoth's external terrain with Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The droid was again present in the hangar [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later during [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] briefing of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] just prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Following his service at Echo Base, R-3PO earned an assignment to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], where he continued to successfully uncover several Imperial infiltration attempts.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Characteristics==
R-3PO was the moodiest droid in Echo Base, a distinction that earned him the ire of those around him. His initial owner, the smuggler Chaz, intentionally left the droid behind for the Rebels to deal with after visiting Echo Base. R-3PO's recognizable red coloring, coupled with his moody persona, led Major Palo Torshan to believe that he would serve perfectly as an espionage droid within the base's droid pool.<ref name="Who's Who" /> R-3PO performed his espionage duties by carefully observing those around him with his<ref name="Who's Who" /> yellow<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="LEGO" /> R-3PO lent his tactical expertise to the Echo Base command center as well.<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

Typical of a protocol droid's responsibilities, R-3PO was designed to mediate the differences of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] wide range of cultures. He was programmed in etiquette and had a considerable ability to speak many different [[Language/Legends|languages]], which he used as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], and other high-ranking officials.<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/11262|text=Star Wars: Cargo Bay - R-3PO, Hoth Evacuation}}</ref>

Aside from his flamboyant red coloring, R-3PO sported a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on his left posterior plating, which read, "Thank The Maker."<ref name="Hoth Limited">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
{{Quote|Thank the Maker! This oil bath is going to feel ''so'' good.|C-3PO's line from ''Star Wars: A New Hope'', inspiring the tattoo worn by R-3PO|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
R-3PO first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in two scenes within Echo Base's hangar, as one of several droid extras.<ref name="ESB" /> The droid was first identified by number on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/r3pOarthreepio.gif "R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)" card] as part of the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], in which his role within the base was defined.<ref name="Hoth Limited" />

R-3PO's tattoo on his left rear, reading "Thank The Maker,"<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> serves as a tribute to the identical line spoken by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] as he is being lowered into an [[Oil bath/Legends|oil bath]].<ref name="ANH" />

===Inconsistencies===
[[File:R-3POalternate.jpg|thumb|right|190px|The alternate R-3PO ''Star Wars'' CCG card, featuring an image of K-3PO]]
The ''Hoth Limited'' ''SWCCG'' set includes an alternate card for R-3PO that mistakenly features an image of [[K-3PO/Legends|K-3PO]], another Echo Base droid extra. The erroneous R-3PO card, which can be seen [[:File:R-3POalternate.jpg|here]], shows the identical image used for the set's K-3PO card, seen [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/k3pokaythreepio.gif here].<ref name="K-3PO">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)}}</ref> Both R-3PO cards otherwise share identical character descriptions.<ref name="Hoth Limited" /><ref name="R-3PO alternate">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)}}</ref>

A discrepancy exists regarding the exact presentation of R-3PO's tattoo. The ''Hoth Limited'' card, which first introduced the tattoo's existence, claims that each first word of the phrase is capitalized: "Thank The Maker."<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> However, the subsequent [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' sources claim the tattoo reads, uncapitalized, "Thank the maker."<ref name="BTM" /><ref name="SWE" /> The [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' presents the entire text capitalized: "THANK THE MAKER,"<ref name="CSWE" /> while the ''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2011]], presents the content in the following context: "R-3PO is thought to sport a tattoo on his left posterior that says 'Thank the Maker,' but there is no sign of it on his LEGO minifigure!", as the figure itself features plain hip and [[Limb/Legends|leg]] pieces.<ref name="LEGO" />
